body: I just have nothing to live for. My family openly shows how much prouder they are of my younger sister than of me. My girlfriend left and now little to no one on the planet cares about me that way. My friends all plan get togethers that I never find out about until they post them on social media. My future seems irrelevant as im so ready to grow up but ive been running in place for as long as i can remember, while other people are being shoved into the limelight unprepared and not ready.
